content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is strong: photo, headline, one orange CTA all above the fold, though phone and directions appear three times (header bar, contact block, fixed bar) before the fold.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works, but the menu section leaves the right half of a wide pale band empty and the '2015' numeral plus wide gaps make the middle of the page feel sparse.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop menu: use the empty right half (second column of dishes or the oven photo) instead of a single 740px list in a full-width band.","Phone: drop the phone/directions row under the header – the fixed bottom bar and the contact block already cover it.","Tighten the '2015' / 'Kdo smo' section: reduce the numeral and the vertical padding so it doesn't read as a dead band on desktop."],"blockers":[]}
